stem.open.welcome.1.speaker: pbp
stem.open.welcome.1.text: Good evening, and welcome in. The building is full, and we are just about ready for hockey.

stem.open.welcome.2.speaker: pbp
stem.open.welcome.2.text: Hello again, everyone. A big crowd in tonight, and a big one on the ice.

stem.open.welcome.3.speaker: pbp
stem.open.welcome.3.text: Welcome along. The anthem is done, the lines are set, and here we go.

stem.open.debut.1.speaker: color
stem.open.debut.1.text: A night he will never forget. First game in the National Hockey League for

bare.open.debut.1.speaker: color
bare.open.debut.1.text: A night he will never forget. A first game in the National Hockey League.

stem.open.debut.2.speaker: color
stem.open.debut.2.text: You only get one debut. Tonight it belongs to

bare.open.debut.2.speaker: color
bare.open.debut.2.text: You only get one debut, and a young man gets his tonight.

stem.open.homecoming.1.speaker: color
stem.open.homecoming.1.text: This building knows him well. Welcome back,

bare.open.homecoming.1.speaker: color
bare.open.homecoming.1.text: This building knows him well. A homecoming tonight.

stem.open.homecoming.2.speaker: color
stem.open.homecoming.2.text: Plenty of history in this rink for

bare.open.homecoming.2.speaker: color
bare.open.homecoming.2.text: Plenty of history in this rink for one man in particular.

stem.open.milestone.1.speaker: color
stem.open.milestone.1.text: Keep an eye on the milestone watch tonight. It is right there for

bare.open.milestone.1.speaker: color
bare.open.milestone.1.text: Keep an eye on the milestone watch tonight. It is right there.

stem.open.milestone.2.speaker: color
stem.open.milestone.2.text: The whole building knows what could happen tonight for

bare.open.milestone.2.speaker: color
bare.open.milestone.2.text: The whole building knows what could happen tonight.

stem.open.banner.1.speaker: pbp
stem.open.banner.1.text: The champions are home, and tonight the banner goes up.

stem.moment.rookieLap.1.speaker: pbp
stem.moment.rookieLap.1.text: The veterans hang back, and out he goes alone. The rookie lap for

bare.moment.rookieLap.1.speaker: pbp
bare.moment.rookieLap.1.text: The veterans hang back, and out he goes alone. The rookie lap.

stem.moment.rookieLap.2.speaker: pbp
stem.moment.rookieLap.2.text: An empty sheet, one lap, and a whole career ahead. Enjoy it,

bare.moment.rookieLap.2.speaker: pbp
bare.moment.rookieLap.2.text: An empty sheet, one lap, and a whole career ahead.

stem.moment.tribute.1.speaker: pbp
stem.moment.tribute.1.text: Up on the video board, a tribute for

bare.moment.tribute.1.speaker: pbp
bare.moment.tribute.1.text: Up on the video board, a tribute for an old friend.

stem.moment.ovation.1.speaker: color
stem.moment.ovation.1.text: Listen to this building. They are on their feet.

stem.moment.ovation.2.speaker: color
stem.moment.ovation.2.text: That is a standing ovation, and he has earned every second of it.

stem.moment.banner.1.speaker: pbp
stem.moment.banner.1.text: And up it goes. Champions, forever, in the rafters.

stem.puckDrop.1.speaker: pbp
stem.puckDrop.1.text: The puck is down, and we are underway.

stem.goal.2.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.2.text: In the back of the net! Goal,

bare.goal.2.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.2.text: In the back of the net! Goal!

stem.goal.goAhead.2.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.goAhead.2.text: He scores, and the lead belongs to them!

bare.goal.goAhead.2.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.goAhead.2.text: He scores, and the lead belongs to them!

stem.goal.lateTie.1.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.lateTie.1.text: Scores! Scores! Tied up late, by

bare.goal.lateTie.2.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.lateTie.2.text: With time running out, they have tied it!

stem.goal.overtime.1.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.overtime.1.text: Overtime winner! It is over, and it is

stem.goal.overtime.2.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.overtime.2.text: He scores, and they win it!

bare.goal.overtime.2.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.overtime.2.text: He scores, and they win it!

stem.goal.hatTrick.1.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.hatTrick.1.text: Here come the hats! A hat trick for

bare.goal.hatTrick.1.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.hatTrick.1.text: Here come the hats! A hat trick!

stem.goal.powerPlay.2.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.powerPlay.2.text: on the power play, and it is in!

bare.goal.powerPlay.2.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.powerPlay.2.text: On the power play, and it is in!

stem.goal.emptyNet.1.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.emptyNet.1.text: Into the empty net, and that one goes to

bare.goal.emptyNet.1.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.emptyNet.1.text: Into the empty net, and that should seal it.

stem.goal.emptyNet.2.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.emptyNet.2.text: That is the empty netter, from

bare.goal.revenge.1.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.revenge.1.text: Against his old team! Of course it is him!

stem.goal.milestone.1.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.milestone.1.text: There it is! A milestone night for

bare.goal.milestone.1.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.milestone.1.text: There it is! A milestone night!

stem.goal.first.1.speaker: pbp
stem.goal.first.1.text: His first in the National Hockey League!

bare.goal.first.1.speaker: pbp
bare.goal.first.1.text: His first in the National Hockey League!

stem.goal.color.1.speaker: color
stem.goal.color.1.text: What a finish. The goalie had no chance on that one.

stem.goal.color.2.speaker: color
stem.goal.color.2.text: Watch the pass that sets it up. That is the whole play.

stem.goal.color.3.speaker: color
stem.goal.color.3.text: They have been knocking on the door, and it finally opens.

stem.goal.color.4.speaker: color
stem.goal.color.4.text: You leave a man that open in the slot, and this is what happens.

stem.save.color.1.speaker: color
stem.save.color.1.text: He had no business getting across for that one.

stem.save.color.2.speaker: color
stem.save.color.2.text: That is a goal ninety nine times out of a hundred.

bare.penalty.1.speaker: pbp
bare.penalty.1.text: And he heads to the box.

stem.penalty.2.speaker: pbp
stem.penalty.2.text: The arm goes up, and that is a penalty on

bare.penalty.2.speaker: pbp
bare.penalty.2.text: The arm goes up, and that is a penalty.

stem.fight.2.speaker: pbp
stem.fight.2.text: They drop them, and here we go!

stem.periodEnd.1.speaker: pbp
stem.periodEnd.1.text: And there is the horn to end the period.

stem.periodEnd.2.speaker: pbp
stem.periodEnd.2.text: That will do it for the period.

stem.gameEnd.1.speaker: pbp
stem.gameEnd.1.text: And that is the final horn.

stem.gameEnd.2.speaker: pbp
stem.gameEnd.2.text: It is over. Handshakes at the benches.

stem.gameEnd.close.1.speaker: pbp
stem.gameEnd.close.1.text: They hang on! That is the final horn!
